phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Triple Quadrupole Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) system incorporating a triple quadrupole mass analyzer for highly sensitive and selective targeted quantitative analysis of chemical and biological molecules.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The triple quadrupole LC–MS configuration is the industry standard for quantitative mass spectrometry used in bioanalysis and pharmaceuticals due to its superior selectivity and sensitivity for multiple reaction monitoring (MRM). It combines an LC front-end with three sequential quadrupole mass analyzers to fragment and detect target ions with high precision, representing the most common architecture in clinical and research laboratories as of 2024.
